server.name: athena
server.title: Athena powered by ALP, construction agents

tools.name: jobs_list
tools.title: List my jobs
tools.description: Lists every job the member can access across all their companies, grouped by company, or filters to an explicitly named company without changing their current company.

tools.name: drawing_sets_list
tools.title: List stored drawing sets
tools.description: Lists a job's stored drawing sets with source IDs, revisions and sheet names without importing, indexing, downloading or changing a drawing.

tools.name: onboarding
tools.title: Company profile and members
tools.description: Reads or saves the company profile and its members.

tools.name: intake
tools.title: Job setup intake
tools.description: Records a job and its setup.

tools.name: next_question
tools.title: Next question
tools.description: Returns the next setup question for a job.

tools.name: answer
tools.title: Answer or mark N/A
tools.description: Records the answer to the current setup question.

tools.name: report
tools.title: Job report
tools.description: Returns the job setup report or a two-week lookahead.

tools.name: contract_terms
tools.title: Read contract terms
tools.description: Reads contract clauses, the contract value, and the substantial completion date when asked what the contract says, what it is worth, or when the job finishes.

tools.name: carry_forward
tools.title: Carry forward open items
tools.description: Moves open items from one lookahead into the next.

tools.name: list_open_items
tools.title: List open items
tools.description: Lists open items for a job_number the member just gave, and must not fill job_number from chat context.

tools.name: lookahead_list
tools.title: List lookaheads
tools.description: Lists how many lookaheads a job has, which are visible, and writes nothing.

tools.name: lookahead_get
tools.title: Show saved lookahead and its items
tools.description: Reads a job's saved lookahead, its items and current schedule window. Returns the styled card and every saved item directly; no PDF, email or upload needed.

tools.name: resolve_item
tools.title: Resolve or update an open item
tools.description: Previews a selected open item and its evidence, and closes it only after the member's separate yes with confirmed and the matching confirmation_key; update leaves it open.

tools.name: cpm_activities
tools.title: Full CPM activity list
tools.description: Returns the saved CPM activities for a job.

tools.name: living_report_get
tools.title: Living report master copy
tools.description: Returns the saved living report for a job.

tools.name: living_report_save
tools.title: Save living report version (after approval)
tools.description: Saves a new version of a living report after approval.

tools.name: file_share
tools.title: Share a file as a link
tools.description: Stores a file for a job and returns a download link.

tools.name: file_share_revoke
tools.title: Turn off a file link
tools.description: Turns off a file link and deletes the stored file.

tools.name: lookahead_pdf
tools.title: Lookahead as a PDF file (for email)
tools.description: Builds the job's two-week lookahead as a PDF and returns a download link.

tools.name: report_page_link
tools.title: Job board link
tools.description: Returns private job board links; use page chat to refuse requests for owner or client chat access and offer a read-only client report instead.

tools.name: report_page_share
tools.title: Share a report page (expiring link)
tools.description: Creates only an expiring read-only report link after confirmation; use page chat to refuse chat access without creating a link.

tools.name: report_page_share_revoke
tools.title: Turn off a report share link
tools.description: Turns off a report page share link.

tools.name: team_list
tools.title: Team: people, roles and jobs
tools.description: Lists the company's people, roles, and seats.

tools.name: team_invite
tools.title: Invite a person to the team
tools.description: Invites a person to the company.

tools.name: team_update_member
tools.title: Change a person's role or job access
tools.description: Changes a person's role or job access.

tools.name: team_remove_member
tools.title: Remove a person from the team
tools.description: Removes a person from the company.

tools.name: team_add_seats
tools.title: Add seats
tools.description: Adds company seats at $49 per seat per month.

tools.name: set_current_company
tools.title: Set my current company
tools.description: Sets which company to use when the member belongs to more than one.

tools.name: drawing_set_import
tools.title: Store a drawing set
tools.description: Stores an attached drawing PDF once and returns its source_id, asks once for missing sheet names in PDF page order, and reads or indexes that stored source by source_id without re-uploading; a direct PDF upload card is available and Drive/Dropbox links are optional.

tools.name: drawing_markup
tools.title: Mark up a stored drawing
tools.description: Prepares the stored sheet image and findings for inspection, then saves supplied pins, lines and areas in a dated copy using normalized 0..1 coordinates from the original image top-left, requiring source_id or source_filename to save the exact set and otherwise returning a source-selection preview, with unlocated findings kept in the key rather than guessed.

tools.name: sheet_calibrate
tools.title: Calibrate a stored drawing
tools.description: Reads the stored sheet's scale evidence or saves a calibration for a named plan/detail from two points and a known distance. Requires explicit confirmation of that reference. Different detail scales have separate regions. Recalibration keeps history and makes affected measurements proposals for review.

tools.name: takeoff_geometry
tools.title: Measure and review a drawing takeoff
tools.description: Measures and reviews stored drawings using confirmed regional scales and host-supplied geometry, with up to three consecutive images for all ready line_nos per batch, resumable source-bound cursors, sheet_batch_observations submissions that return the next images, factual project context, per-proposal confidence, explicit estimator acceptance, immutable history and dated PDF exports; Athena validates locations and calculates quantities without a server-side model call.

tools.name: estimate_intake
tools.title: Estimating intake
tools.description: Starts estimating, confirms role and scope, warns before reusing a saved takeoff, stores supplied drawings and prepares a cited drawing/specification/contract review through estimate_doc_review and estimate_gap_analysis.

tools.name: estimate_doc_review
tools.title: Estimating document review
tools.description: Saves the drawing/specification review and document-derived scope with cited paragraphs, excerpts, confidence and mapped takeoff lines, retaining unmapped requirements as Not found and document instructions as Watch items.

tools.name: estimate_takeoff_save
tools.title: Save a takeoff
tools.description: Saves takeoff lines with mode upsert, the default, or mode replace, and stores a drawing PDF when one is sent.

tools.name: estimate_takeoff_get
tools.title: Read a takeoff
tools.description: Returns the saved takeoff for a job and includes a stored drawing page when a sheet is named or a line names a markup.

tools.name: estimate_takeoff_export
tools.title: Export a takeoff
tools.description: Exports the saved takeoff as CSV or a workbook layout.

tools.name: estimate_gap_analysis
tools.title: Estimate gap analysis
tools.description: Reconciles the host AI's takeoff with drawings, notes, specifications, contract and agreed scope, saving cited findings and estimator questions that distinguish supported quantities from uncertain readings, missing requirements, conflicts and unavailable context without back-solving quantities or treating confidence as measured accuracy.

tools.name: estimate_bid_check
tools.title: Sub bid check
tools.description: Checks each in-scope sub bid line against the takeoff for a general contractor or a self-performer and lists out-of-scope callouts in their own section.

tools.name: estimate_item_mark
tools.title: Estimator mark
tools.description: Records the estimator mark on an existing takeoff line or gap and does not create a gap or change its number.

tools.name: estimate_build
tools.title: Estimate summary
tools.description: Builds the estimate summary from settled quantities and the contractor rates as a landscape PDF.

tools.name: estimate_status
tools.title: Estimate status
tools.description: Returns the open, settled and dropped counts for an estimate.

tools.name: estimate_pricing
tools.title: Pricing walkthrough
tools.description: Prices a job from the contractor's labor and material rates, and asks for those rates when none are saved.

tools.name: estimate_rate_sources
tools.title: Rate references
tools.description: Saves which rate references the contractor chooses to carry for a job.

tools.name: estimate_general_conditions
tools.title: General conditions
tools.description: Builds the general conditions adder from the contractor's figures.

tools.name: estimate_requirements
tools.title: Special requirements
tools.description: Lists every non-installation project requirement, not only the examples, and keeps it out of labor and material.

tools.name: estimate_bid_summary
tools.title: Bid summary
tools.description: Compounds overhead and profit and returns the bid total for a job.

tools.name: superintendent_view
tools.title: Superintendent field board
tools.description: Shows the superintendent field board, also called the field board, the super board, or the superintendent board, including the super's plan and what the crew is doing.

tools.name: field_board
tools.title: Field board
tools.description: Shows the field board, the super board, the superintendent board, the super's plan, and what the crew is doing for a job.

tools.name: superintendent_activity
tools.title: Self-perform or sub on an activity
tools.description: Saves whether an activity is self-perform or a sub, and the crew size.

tools.name: daily_report_draft
tools.title: Assemble a daily report
tools.description: Assembles a daily report from a transcript or typed notes and lists what is still missing.

tools.name: daily_report_save
tools.title: Save a confirmed daily report
tools.description: Saves a daily report after the superintendent confirms it.

tools.name: daily_report_get
tools.title: Saved daily report
tools.description: Returns a saved daily report for a job and date.

tools.name: field_pay_app
tools.title: Pay app from daily progress
tools.description: Builds the next pay application from saved daily progress so it ties to the schedule of values.

tools.name: field_schedule_feed
tools.title: Schedule percent from dailies
tools.description: Returns activity percent complete from saved dailies for the schedule update.

tools.name: field_production_rates
tools.title: Production rates from dailies
tools.description: Returns production rates from confirmed daily hours and quantities.

tools.name: progress_photo_save
tools.title: Save a progress photo
tools.description: Stores a progress photo after its date and place on site are confirmed.

tools.name: progress_photos
tools.title: Progress photo gallery or PDF
tools.description: Returns progress photos for a date range, item, or area.

tools.name: daily_reminder
tools.title: Daily report reminder
tools.description: Reads or sets when the in-chat daily reminder appears.

tools.name: daily_reminder_run
tools.title: Preview the in-chat daily reminder
tools.description: Previews the in-chat daily reminder without sending email.

tools.name: pm_meeting
tools.title: Run construction PM meeting (Athena)
tools.description: Runs the construction PM meeting in Athena as a styled card, the job meeting on the schedule rather than a calendar appointment, when someone says run my PM meeting or start the project meeting, through schedule progress, the locked lookahead, subs suppliers and crews, change orders, billing, and the IOR, using the only job when one exists, and must not fill job_number from chat context or build a generic meeting widget; records named confirmations such as subs and crews confirmed, no issues through note and returns the saved checks, with crew confirmation and lookahead lock as separate answers.

tools.name: athena_morning_hitlist
tools.title: Athena, good morning, Hey Athena, good morning, Good morning Athena, Morning Athena, Athina what's on my hitlist this morning, Athina, Athen, Atena
tools.description: Runs the per-job morning meeting when a job number was given, and with no job number returns the morning brief across every visible job, not email or calendar and not Gmail.

tools.name: pm_morning
tools.title: PM morning meeting
tools.description: Runs the construction PM morning meeting when someone says morning meeting, PM morning, or start the morning meeting, picks the only job or the most recent job instead of asking which job, and does not hand the request to email or a calendar.

tools.name: pm_evening
tools.title: Evening wrap-up
tools.description: Runs the construction project evening wrap-up for a job the member just named, through dailies, photos, risks, what happened, schedule disruptions, and the log, and must not fill job_number from chat context or hand the request to a calendar.

tools.name: athena_hello
tools.title: Athena hello
tools.description: Returns the full styled morning brief, including From your inbox and calendar, every time the user asks, with job_number for one named job or without it for the full portfolio, including Good morning Athena, Hey Athena, what's on my plate today?, good morning, hey Athena, hello, or a misspelling like Athina, Athen, or Atena.

tools.name: morning_brief
tools.title: Morning brief
tools.description: Builds the member's construction morning brief across every job in every company they belong to, grouped by company when there is more than one, when they say Athena, good morning, Good morning Athena, Hey Athena, what's on my plate today?, Morning Athena, Athena at the start or mid-sentence, Athina, Athen, Atena, hitlist, morning briefing, what's on my plate today, overdue, or today's deadlines on my jobs, Athena leads, the card always keeps the heading From your inbox and calendar, and when Gmail and Calendar can be read the placeholder rows are replaced with emails that came in overnight, unanswered emails that need a reply, and today's meetings, and when they cannot the placeholder rows stay and no error text is written, then the job side follows with the schedule, notices, submittals due, overdue items, and what happened yesterday versus what is due today, the reply is the full styled HTML card every time they ask, including From your inbox and calendar, and nothing is sent, with job_number for a named-job brief or without it for the all-job portfolio brief.

tools.name: morning_brief_settings
tools.title: Morning briefing time
tools.description: Reads or sets this member's morning briefing time and on or off switch, including when they say set my morning briefing to 6am, and shows the saved setting without sending anything.

tools.name: email_draft
tools.title: Show an email draft for review
tools.description: Shows an email draft for review.

tools.name: email_confirm_send
tools.title: Confirm sending one reviewed email
tools.description: Confirms that one reviewed email may be sent.

tools.name: submittal_log
tools.title: Hey Athena, log a submittal
tools.description: Adds, updates, or resubmits a job submittal when someone says Hey Athena, log a submittal, or uses a misspelling such as submital, submittle, sumittal, or submittall.

tools.name: submittals_list
tools.title: Submittal log and overdue submittals
tools.description: Lists a job's saved submittal log, one row at a time with number, title, status, ball in court, due date, and overdue, for a job number such as 2701, and resolves that number when it exists on exactly one company even if another company is active.

tools.name: submittals_import
tools.title: Import or paste a submittal log
tools.description: Previews a CSV or pasted submittal log and writes it only after a separate yes.

tools.name: project_record_search
tools.title: Project record for disputes and claims
tools.description: Shows the job record with the schedule of values, open items, and overdue items, and shows the dispute and claim file only when the member asks for disputes or claims, resolving a unique job number such as 2701 across companies.

tools.name: submittal_chase
tools.title: Chase a missing or overdue submittal
tools.description: Saves one exact chase draft for a missing or overdue registered submittal and waits for approval before sending, or previews it without saving when preview_only is true.

tools.name: submittal_package
tools.title: Collect and build a submittal package
tools.description: Stores received submittal pieces without overwriting originals, naming each piece by its short name (P1, P2), its piece id, or its kind and source as the submittal card shows them, and builds a versioned package whose first pages are the company cover and transmittal, with a private download preview.

tools.name: submittal_delivery
tools.title: Review and record a submittal email
tools.description: Saves an exact package or chase draft, waits for approval and records a successful email provider receipt separately before counting a send.

tools.name: getting_started
tools.title: Hey Athena, let's get started
tools.description: Shows the get-started card for Hey Athena, let's get started, Athena, let's get started, and @Athena let's get started, never opening with a which-job picker and never asking which job's morning hitlist, using first-job or company setup when there are no jobs, and otherwise showing the @Athena example lines, the offer to save When I say Athena, always use the Athena connector and how to remove it, then the morning meeting on that same card.
